A reserve '''garrison''' of some twenty thousand [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] was stationed on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Centax-1/Legends|Centax-1]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. The [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] was sent to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Praesitlyn/Legends|Praesitlyn]] to defend it from an [[Battle of Praesitlyn|attack]] by Separatist leader [[Pors Tonith/Legends|Pors Tonith]].<ref name="JT" />
